Format Premiere - Tatooine: posted 2 August 2001, before Coruscant was legal, and the list has no Coruscant-set card.
The 'Weapons & Devices (10)' header line is not a card.

Posted 'Tatooine' and 'Cantina' dested the Light Premiere printings Tatooine (Light) (Premiere) and Tatooine: Cantina (Light); 'Artoo' dested the Light Jabba's Palace Artoo (the era's only plain Artoo; Artoo, Brave Little Droid is Theed Palace).

Posted 'Fire Extinquisher', 'Medium Bulk Frieghter', 'It'sNot My Fault', 'Wookie Strangle', 'A Few Manuevers' and 'Sqaudron assignments' are misspellings of Fire Extinguisher, Medium Bulk Freighter, It's Not My Fault!, Wookiee Strangle, A Few Maneuvers and Squadron Assignments; 'Sorry About ... &Blaster Prof.' dested Sorry About The Mess & Blaster Proficiency.
Jason Herrin's existing wiki page lists him under the DeckTech handle Mr. Black; this post uses the handle azreal6 (same name, same era).
